items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the splitting principle at source lines 5003-5017, label lemma-splitting-principle, whose proof occupies source lines 5019-5040. The proof is an induction on the total rank which simultaneously produces the covering morphism and keeps track of the two properties demanded of it. The key step passes to the projective bundle of a sheaf of rank greater than one, uses that the canonical surjection onto the tautological quotient has a locally free kernel of rank one less, and replaces the sheaf by that kernel so that the total rank drops by one; injectivity of pullback along the projection is supplied by the projective bundle formula for every base change, which is what allows the statement to be checked upstairs. The counted statement records neither the induction nor the substitution by the kernel.
